[...]
Scott McTominay has been kept separate from the rest of the Scotland squad with the midfielder a doubt for their World Cup opener against Haiti.
[...]
McTominay missed training on Thursday at Scotland’s base in Charlotte as he deals with an upset stomach, and was not on the team bus as it arrived at a hotel in Boston ahead of Saturday night’s fixture.
[...]
The Napoli midfielder was instead accompanied by a doctor as a precautionary measure as Steve Clarke looks to avoid the possibility of the illness spreading through his squad.
[...]
Fellow midfielder Kenny McLean is hopeful that McTominay will be able to feature as Scotland return to the World Cup for the first time in 28 years.
[...]
“Hopefully that doesn't spread,” McLean said of the illness. “Fingers crossed Scott will be fine. I'm sure he will be.
[...]
The clash with Haiti at Boston Stadium in Foxborough will kick off in the early hours of Sunday morning Scottish time, though a healthy contingent of fans have travelled to the United States to support the side.
[...]
Injured midfielder Billy Gilmour has also arrived in Boston to support the squad having had his hopes of featuring in the World Cup ended by a cruelly-timed injury sustained in the warm-up fixture against Curacao.

"He deserves so much more but there is going to be so much more opportunity for Billy. I know it's not what he wants to hear right now but there will be.

results.title: Scott McTominay misses Scotland training as SFA give reason for absence - and another player away from group
highlights:
Scott McTominay misses Scotland training as SFA give reason for absence - and another player away from group
[...]
Napoli midfielder suffering from a stomach bug - but should make Haiti
[...]
Scott McTominay missed Scotland training on Thursday as he recovers from a stomach bug ahead of the World Cup.
[...]
McTominay sat out the morning session due to illness, with the Scotland coaching staff keen for the Napoli midfielder to make a swift recovery and not pass on the bug to anyone else.
[...]
It is understood that the Scotland camp are confident McTominay will be available for Sunday’s Group C opener against Haiti. Scotland are currently at their base in Charlotte and will fly to to Boston on Friday to conduct pre-match commitments and train at the stadium in Foxborough.
[...]
McTominay has been capped 70 times for Scotland and scored in the 4-0 weekend win over Bolivia in New Jersey. He has emerged as a talismanic figure for the national team and would normally be one of the first names on head coach Steve Clarke’s team sheet.
[...]
McTominay will enter a period of recovery before being brought back into the main group.
[...]
Another player who was not with the full squad is central defender Scott McKenna, who recently won his 50th cap for Scotland. The Dinamo Zagreb man is recovering from a small knock and underwent an individual training session on his own on Thursday.
[...]
McKenna is vying with Grant Hanley, Jack Hendry, John Souttar and Dom Hyam for a place in the starting XI against Haiti, with Clarke expected to deploy a back four for the opening match.

# Billy Gilmour jets in for Scotland celebration amid injury woes as Scott McTominay question remains - Daily Record
[...]
Billy Gilmour jets in for Scotland celebration amid injury woes as Scott McTominay question remains - Daily Record
[...]
# Billy Gilmour jets in for Scotland celebration amid injury woes as Scott McTominay question remains
[...]
## The Napoli midfielder was ruled out of the tournament after suffering a heartbreaking injury in the warm-up friendly with Curacao
[...]
Stricken Billy Gilmour has checked into Scotland’s camp here in Boston - as fears grow that Scott McTominay might be the next big name to be KO'd from Saturday’s World Cup opener, writes Keith Jackson in America.
[...]
Gilmour was reunited Steve Clarke’s squad on Thursday night almost a fortnight after his dream of starring on the biggest stage of all was shattered by a knee injury suffered during the Hampden send-off against Curacao on May 30.
[...]
And now his Napoli team mate McTominay is also sparking concerns ahead of the Group C opener against Haiti after missing training with a suspected dose of food poisoning.
[...]
The medics are confident that McTominey will recover in time but he was missing from the final session at Charlotte’s FC’s state of the art facility before the team made the 850 mile trip north to Massachusetts.
[...]
Clarke’s medical department, meanwhile, was busy attending to McTominey who is believed to have spent the previous 24 hours feeling unwell and repeatedly vomiting.
[...]
But McLean is confident that the team’s talisman.will declare himself fit and ready for action ahead of kick-off on Saturday night.
[...]
McLean said: “Hopefully that doesn’t spread. I am sure everybody has fingers crossed that Scotty will be fine and I’m sure he will be.
[...]
But McLean has a hunch that Clarke’s side could quickly become one of the biggest surprise packages at the tournament.
[...]
He said: “Obviously we want to be that team but we know it is going to be difficult. As I have mentioned previously, the last couple of weeks have been amazing, focussing on what we can do to be that team and be as good as we can be.
[...]
“The quality that we have, we know we can be that team. But the full focus right now is on Saturday. That is all it can be. We can’t look too far ahead, we can’t start looking at the history we can make.
[...]
“Saturday is so huge and crucial for us and that’s what this build up has been about, this week especially, Haiti. We will go there and try to win the game, we feel we definitely can but it is all down to us.”
